newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-HOLDERS AUXERRE MEET VERVINS IN DAVID AND GOLIATH CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOLDERS AUXERRE MEET VERVINS IN DAVID AND GOLIATH CLASH.

text.p: Auxerre open their defence of the French Cup away to minor league side Vervins in mid-January.
Vervins were the lowest ranked survivors to go into Friday's draw for the first round, when the big fish of the first division come in.
There are two all-first division clashes in the first round to be played on January 18 and 19.
Marseille, who eliminated Auxerre from the League Cup last month, meet Lille and Metz face Montpellier.
European Cup Winners' Cup holders Paris Saint-Germain were drawn against third division Besancon.
Nimes, the third division side who reached the final last season, meet Toulouse on Sunday for a place in the first round.
